label: end of original phase / <DEL> in long sequences that start with h
explanation: Fires almost only at the <DEL> step (82% of mass) and the last 1-3 original tokens just before it; never in the copy phase and never at t<5. Magnitude is dominated by the first original token (the one about to be output at <DEL>): first token h gives 70% of mass and all top activations (~0.5-1.0 of max at <DEL>), followed by x, l, m with weaker lift. Activation also grows with sequence length: zero for L<=4, rare for L=5, strongest for L=8-9, and it ramps up over the final original steps. Weak, low-magnitude firing on <DEL> in long sequences with other first tokens accounts for most missed activations. h-first sequences of length 3-5 do not fire.

scorecard.summary: Graded preference over the first original token (most: h, x, l, m, r, 1; least: w, c, a, t) and the second original token (most: h, b, m, z, l, 0; least: y, a, c, t); timing cues that raise it most: t=8, t=7, L=9 & t=8.
